symbols.read: The 736.65 trigger never broke cleanly — price is 739.29, still above it, so the SELL setup is invalidated and the downside case is now unconfirmed rather than active. What changed from the prior read: the 1H flip to down has persisted and combined reads now agree on SELL, but the open-FVG list is empty, meaning there is no structural cushion on either side and price is trading on raw pivots. Bias stays cautiously bearish, contingent on a decisive break of 736.65 to reopen 733.68–735.98 and 714.86; reclaiming 758.44 voids the downside entirely. Until 736.65 gives way, this is a coiled range, not a short.

The bullish bias from the prior read is now void: price has dropped from 83,479.87 to 82,924.11, the 1H trend has flipped down, and the combined 4H+1H signal is SELL with 4H direction bearish. The deeper 82,471.18–82,782.95 bull FVG has been filled, leaving no open FVGs, so the pullback structure that supported the upside is gone. Price is now pressing toward the 82,285.71 lower pivot, which remains the structural line — a decisive break below it opens 80,219.42, while reclaiming and holding above 82,285.71 would be needed to neutralize the bearish tilt. Bias is now bearish toward 80,219.42, with invalidation on a sustained recovery back above the 82,285.71 pivot.

ETHUSDT has flipped from HOLD to SELL: price at 2,484.01 is now pressing the 2,474.34 lower pivot from above, and the combined 4H+1H stance has shifted to SELL with the 1H trend down and the last 1H candle -0.11%. The bull FVG at 2,466.47–2,486.84 that previously cushioned price has dropped out of the open-FVG list, leaving no open FVGs and removing the structural support that kept the prior read neutral. Bias is bearish: a decisive break of 2,474.34 targets 2,368.80, with the 2,481.38 stop defining invalidation of the short setup. Reclaiming 2,579.88 remains the condition to flip back bullish.

Price has broken below the 107.16 lower pivot to 105.70, confirming the 4H bearish direction and flipping the combined bias back to SELL — the short setup that was invalidated in the prior read is now re-armed by this level break. The 1H trend remains down and the last candle is negative (107.21→107.17), so momentum agrees with the breakdown. With no open FVGs, there is no imbalance overhead to stall the move toward the 100.92 target. Invalidation is a reclaim of 107.16 on a 4H close, with 113.40 still the hard cap that voids the bearish case.

Bias remains bearish and has extended: price has now broken below the 58.67 lower pivot to 58.48, deepening the breakdown from the prior 58.68 print and keeping the 4H direction bearish. The overhead bearish FVG stack at 59.059–59.109, 59.546–59.6345, 59.832–60.0325, and 60.1855–60.21 is unchanged, so sellers still cap every bounce below 60.21. The setup is live with entry at 58.67, stop at 58.83, and target at 55.88, a shallower objective than the prior 56.26 but consistent with the continued grind lower. Invalidation is a reclaim of 61.45, unchanged; regime has shifted from NEUTRAL to BEARISH, so the prior size caution is lifted.

Bias has firmed back to bearish: the prior HOLD/watch has resolved into an active SELL as price slid to 4,139.47 and the 4H direction, 1H trend, and combined read now all align down under a BEARISH regime. The 4,173.19–4,177.56 bear FVG remains the overhead cap, while the 4,158–4,162 shelf that flipped to resistance last read is now clearly behind price, confirming the lower structure. The trade is set at the 4,131.81 lower pivot, stop 4,138.56, target 4,046.23, with the 4,131.81 level itself the immediate trigger to watch. Invalidation is unchanged: a sustained reclaim and hold above 4,173–4,177 revives the bullish 4H case and kills the short.

Price has broken below the 1.37 lower pivot to 1.36, confirming the neutral-to-short lean from the prior read and flipping the combined tag to SELL — the 4H stays bearish and the 1H trend remains down. The short entry at 1.37 is now marked invalidated since price has already traded through it, but the directional bias holds: 1.31 remains the downside target with no open FVGs to slow or accelerate the move. The 1.43 upper pivot is still the bullish trigger, though the BULLISH regime label conflicts with the bearish 4H and combined SELL, so treat it as stale until reclaimed. Invalidation: a decisive 4H close back above 1.43 revives the long, while sustained trade under 1.37 keeps 1.31 in play.
